name: Option 14
definition: Derivative instrument that gives the buyer the right but not the obligation to purchase a set of quantity of a financial instrument at a future date.

OptionStyle.name: Option Style
OptionStyle.definition: Specifies how the option can be exercised.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether the option is a call or a put.

BarrierIndicator.name: Barrier Indicator
BarrierIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the option has a barrier.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: Specifies the event in the life of the option.
